title: Standalone saved MCP definition snapshot
summary: Validate that saved JSON tool definitions outside a skill count as MCP snapshots, not skill packages.
why_it_works: The supported tools array is inspected as decoded JSON and classified separately from skills. This is a saved definition, not an inspection of a running MCP server. The tool name is not a frontmatter skill or agent name.
mitigations: Keep saved-definition inspection separate from runtime server verification.
